name: Espis Zanchal's droid
description: The baron and lord Espis Zanchal of the Galactic Empire owned a droid that served him at the Zanchal Estate on the planet Coruscant. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the baron was mentioned in a list of members of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, prompting the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader to send his crew of assassins to eliminate him.
